name: what-i-did-copilot
displayName: What I Did — Copilot Impact Report
description: Generate a branded HTML impact report of what GitHub Copilot helped you accomplish — pick a date range, click Generate, view it in the editor.

commands.title: What I Did: Open Report Builder
What I Did: Generate Report (last settings)

whatidid.pythonPath.description: Path to the Python interpreter used to run the report. Leave empty to auto-detect (uses the Python extension's selected interpreter, then falls back to 'python').

whatidid.scriptPath.description: Full path to whatidid.py. Leave empty to use the copy bundled with this extension, or to auto-detect one in the open workspace.

whatidid.openInEditor.description: After generating, preview the report inside VS Code. When off, the report only opens in your default browser.
